subject: Next steps: rotating deep-dive windows for WellPath
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Sana Riaz <sana@wellpathhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: rotating deep-dive windows for WellPath

Hi Sana / Michael — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in the technical deep-dive.

Recap (30 min discovery):
- Primary business goal: reduce inference cost for transcript summarization while keeping sub-500ms p99 token latency for live review.
- Data constraints: PHI-adjacent; customer prefers private deployment options and audit logs.
- Team for deep-dive: Sana (product), Michael (infra), plus 2 engineers (TBD).

We recommended a 60-minute technical deep-dive to cover: model candidate tradeoffs, latency profiles, batching/kv-cache approach, and a short checklist for Private/VPC onboarding.

Scheduling challenge: Your team spans US/EU/APAC. To be mindful of working hours, we propose a rotating weekly window so the burden is shared across your team — one week early US-friendly, next week EU-friendly, next week APAC-friendly. Attached is a draft invite with three rotating slots and a one-page discovery summary.

Proposed first three-week rotation (local times shown):
- Week A (US-friendly): Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 GMT
- Week B (EU-friendly): Wed 16:00 GMT / 11:00 ET / 03:00 AEST
- Week C (APAC-friendly): Thu 09:00 AEST / 16:00 GMT / 11:00 PT

Can you confirm which week you'd like to start with and who from your engineering team will join? If you prefer specific fixed slots instead of a rotation, tell us and we'll adapt.

Next actions from our side:
- I'll send the rotating invite (ICS) and a short discovery notes PDF.
- Grace will create a focused agenda and pre-read for the deep-dive.
- Ben will prepare a checklist for Private deployment pre-reqs.

Attachments: [discovery-notes.pdf (14 KB)] [Invite: rotating-slots.ics]

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Rafael — appreciate the concise recap.

We like the rotation concept. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Start week: let's begin Week B (EU-friendly) — better for our engineering lead's current schedule.
- Attendees: Michael (infra), myself, plus Aaron Park (senior eng, will invite from our side). He prefers late-morning GMT.
- Security: we'll need a short pre-call with your security contact to review SOC 2 questions before the deep-dive — 15 minutes should suffice.

Can you confirm the Week B slot you propose (Wed 16:00 GMT) and include a 15-minute security sync 48 hours before the deep-dive? Monica, can you own the pre-read distribution from Redwood?

Thanks — Sana
